whole_text: --- title: "Avatar · image · mask · idol" record_id: mytheme-avatar-image-mask-idol record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authored image ecology; source-specific comparisons separately attributed" world: frank-taylor geography: "Authorial world; comparison settings retain their separate geographical identities" time: "Taylor's 2026 development; ancient tellings, later psychological reception and modern media remain distinct" development_status: writer-complete-parent-T22-pending --- # Avatar · image · mask · idol ## #0 Presence becomes addressable through a form. This authored Mytheme follows how that form makes encounter possible and how its success can turn into possession. A face turns towards someone; a name lets that person be called again; a gesture carries an intention into a shared situation. A role gives an undertaking a recognisable place. Someone can now be met, remembered, trusted, opposed or answered. The form's finitude lets this encounter occur here, between these participants. The whole begins with this gift of mediation. A person does not first become complete in isolation and subsequently add a public mask. Language, bodily expression, histories of recognition and shared practices participate in the life that appears. Yet no achieved presentation finishes that life. The person who was named can answer differently; the person remembered can have changed; the one approached through a role can question what the role permits. Maintained personhood is this consequential continuity through different appearances, including the capacity to alter how one is received. Taylor's [avatar–image–mask–idol programme](../../../../../../../working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/MYTHEME-AND-DEEP-SOURCE-SEAMS.md) develops one authored ecology through four distinguishable offices. Avatar concerns presence becoming effective in a finite appearance. Image concerns the particular formation that gathers attention and value. Mask concerns the presentation through which participation becomes possible. Idol concerns the closure by which a successful formation takes possession of the authority it was meant to mediate. These offices can meet in one form; their relation is not a historical claim that four traditions tell one story. The native ground is the complete relation articulated in [Taylor's core](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md): parent `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, and return `1/0`. The form is a determination within that movement, not its self-sufficient origin. Question can address assertion; an instance can expose the capacity through which it was formed; the personed encounter can change the account; the achieved account can return as a condition of another determination. The six passages of this whole follow that possibility through appearance, efficacy, participation, capture and renewed address. They do not assign an extra native position to each of its four names. ## #1 The avatar brings a wider presence into a particular encounter. In this authored use, descent names the movement into a form that can act: a voice rather than every possible voice, a gesture rather than intention without expression, an entrusted representative rather than an undertaking with no bearer. The presence is not made unreal by having an appearance. It acquires an occasion on which it can matter. That occasion preserves a difference of office. A representative can speak authoritatively within a commission; the representative's statement remains answerable to what was entrusted. Even the original instruction is already a formulation. It cannot exhaust the intention simply because it was written first. [Authored Ground and Positional Delegation](../../../../episteme/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **grounds** this recursive relation: the human, institution or agent occupying a source-position is situated in a wider field, and the prompt is already a determination. Authority can be exact and effective without becoming absolute sourcehood. The avatar's body belongs to the encounter it enters. A voice needs someone who can hear it; a gesture acquires consequences in a shared situation; an entrusted representative inherits a commission and answers through what the representation does. The source relation passes into action, where another participant can accept, question or refuse it. That response becomes part of the form's history. Taylor's avatar names this effective finite presence; the particular Sanskrit and theological histories retain their separate source tasks. An image makes that presence available under a particular arrangement. The arrangement can be faithful without being exhaustive. A remembered face, an emblem or a written account selects; selection gives recognition its precision. The source/reflection distinction also has direction. A reflection can be encountered first in time while remaining dependent on what it reflects. Within a declared Context Frame, an achieved image or source record can genuinely occupy **Bimba**, the local original against which further readings are compared. The same field occupies **pratibimba**, situated reflection, relative to its wider sources. [Bimba–Pratibimba](../../../../episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **grounds** this recursive office: the local original gives agreement and error a definite reference, and what those comparisons return can revise that original itself. Its authority is real at the scale of the inquiry. Idolisation begins when it prevents its own source relation from being questioned or changed. ## #2 The image gathers force. Attention returns to it; desire and fear organise themselves around it; expectations begin to make some possibilities vivid and others difficult to receive. A picture that once expressed a situation can become a measure for the next situation. The person making or interpreting it is changed through that activity. The formation acquires a history, and its later efficacy includes what its earlier appearances have done. [Symbolon Dynamics](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE.md) **sources** this native reciprocal movement. Archetypal capacity, particular image and organising complex have different offices. An archetype is not one finished portrait; an image is not the whole capacity from which further images can arise; a complex organises a field of response around a consequential formation. Attention, libido, desire and valuation name different aspects or registers of that efficacy. Their relation here does not turn them into interchangeable physical energies. The shared [Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md) **grounds** the archetypal structuration through which this image ecology takes form. The round holds the parental relation before its differentiated figures appear. Nourishing and engulfing faces of origin give dependence its contrary possibilities; separation of the world parents opens a world in which powers can be distinguished. The hero gains an effective position within that world, then encounters the limits of identifying life with the victorious image. Transformation returns the achieved differentiation into relation with what it had subordinated or excluded. Each formation carries a capacity that its own established image can subsequently confine. Taylor's encounter with [Neumann's source](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **sources** the extension through the whole native field: relation, conscious circumstance, question and assertion, withdrawal and extension, determining capacity and instance, personed context, differential horizon and return. The complementary folds remain active within this movement: question answers in a personed world, felt force acquires a readable pattern, and the conscious circumstance retains its inexhaustible depth. This universal structuration is Taylor's argued appointment. Neumann's ego-development sequence supplies a distinct psychological account; it neither limits the native field to ego chronology nor assigns each culture a position on that sequence. The image's efficacy reaches the body as well as its account. In Taylor's *Symbolon Dynamics*, libido concerns psychic investment and valuation; prāṇa concerns living circulation through breath, rhythm and differentiated current; Śakti concerns manifestation-power, including the concealment of source within its formation and its return through recognition. A repeated image can gather desire, alter the rhythm of attention and make a once-unavailable response possible. These registers disclose different operations of that efficacy. Their coordination belongs to Taylor's synthesis; their names do not license a common physical measurement or transfer one tradition's evidence into another. An image's success therefore creates the pressure that will test it. A form that has held a life together has a claim upon attention. Revising it can threaten a valued coherence, an institution's continuity or a familiar account of oneself. The test concerns what this coherence can receive. If a new encounter changes the meaning, valuation or jurisdiction of the image, symbolic efficacy remains alive. If every encounter must confirm it, the interpreter's apparent fidelity begins to protect the image from the relation that made it significant. The whole **returns-to** [Image, Valuation and Possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) through this change in authority. An image mediates while its source relation remains active; idolisation appropriates that relation. A vivid or beloved image is not thereby an idol. Nor does a quiet, abstract or apparently rational account escape the test. The decisive change is in authority: whether the encountered source can still alter what the image is allowed to mean and do. ## #3 The image becomes a mask when it offers a way to enter a social field. Language, manner, clothing, credentials and the expectations of a role make someone legible to others. A mask can protect an intimacy, sustain a public obligation or let a person exercise capacities that would otherwise have no recognised place. Learning to wear it is an achievement of participation. There is no demand here for a person to become completely exposed in order to be real. The pressure appears when access depends upon the presentation so completely that its bearer must administer life according to the recognising field's measure. What began as an interface becomes an internal criterion. The person anticipates what will count, edits what can be shown and may come to receive an unapproved response as a defect in the self. The mask continues to open doors while narrowing the life that can pass through them. This is the programme's argued operation of self-administration, not a clinical diagnosis or an empirical claim about every use of a social role. The mask/chameleon seam retains a specific pressure: adaptation can grant access while requiring a bearer to reproduce the measure that renders parts of that bearer illegible. The surrounding field acts through the person's acquired skill in navigating it. The whole's present operation is this passage from participation into self-administration. The quilt holds its Fanonian and biographical development for a separate source-bearing recovery; those racial and colonial histories remain distinct from this general authored relation. The distinction is sharply staged in [*The Prisoner*](../../../../episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/mcgoohan-markstein/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner/SOURCE.md). After resignation, an unnamed intelligence agent is abducted into the Village and designated Number Six. Changing occupants hold the office of Number Two; the identity of Number One remains the question. When Six asks who One is, the answer assigns Six his place. Numbering gives the administrative office continuity across its occupants and gives the captive an identity the institution can administer. The question about power's source has been diverted into power's classification of the questioner. The series' concluding *Fall Out* returns this question through masks and Six's own face, then through escape and an unresolved London return. That inward turn does not cancel the Village's coercive apparatus or declare captivity imaginary. The source house's finale account remains a written-witness recovery, distinct from a fully collated audiovisual sequence. In Taylor's refraction the return reaches both the institution and the claimant to sovereignty within the person. Replacing an administrator or removing a mask does not alone make the governing relation answerable. The programme's Two and Six also retain their dramatic office; they supply no proof of the native `4+2` generation. ## #4 The idol closes the path through the image. The bearer remains visible, perhaps more widely represented than before, while losing the ability to change the terms under which the representation acts. The category is permitted to know the person before encounter. Contrary speech is then classified as further evidence of the category. The image need not become inaccurate in every detail. Its protected jurisdiction lets even an accurate local description govern what exceeds that description. Ovid's [Apollo and Daphne sequence](../../../../episteme/sources/classical-philology/ovid/ovid-1921-metamorphoses-miller/SOURCE.md) gives this continued efficacy an exact body. Apollo's boast after Python leads to Cupid's opposed arrows. Daphne's prior refusal of marriage and Peneus's grant of that wish precede the pursuit. Apollo's powers do not make his desire hers. Exhaustion, appeal and transformation end with the laurel: the changed body is still felt as living, recoils from the kiss, and is claimed for Apollo's emblems. The ending also gives the tree an appearance of assent. Both details must remain; neither authorises replacing the whole encounter with uncomplicated consent. The authored image–idol reading concerns the emblem's power to continue after possession of the living other has failed. Roman literary telling, its Greek figures and its later interpretation retain different places and times. The [biblical Job witness](../../../../episteme/sources/biblical-studies/anonymous/biblical-job-kjv-ebible-eng-kjv2006/SOURCE.md) tests a different image: an account of divine justice. The councils, successive losses, bodily affliction and wife's challenge precede the friends' explanations. Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar first mourn and sit silently with Job; their later advocacy must be read against that initial accompaniment. Job's protest and defence of integrity resist an explanation which would require him to become the guilty person it needs. Wisdom in chapter 28 exceeds extraction and purchase; Elihu's separate intervention precedes the whirlwind. The divine speeches bring a world and creatures beyond Job's administration without explaining the councils to him. His response is followed by the friends' rebuke and their need for his intercession. Renewed household and social life do not erase the first children's deaths. Taylor's protected-account reading follows this change in who can be heard and who must receive another's mediation. Jung's [*Answer to Job* comparison, §§614–617](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE.md#jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11-q002) has a separate office: he reads the treatment of the faithful witness as a crisis of the God-image requiring self-reflection and remembrance of Sophia. That is an attributed psychological interpretation. Sophia is not introduced as an actor in biblical Job 28, and Jung's reconstruction does not become Taylor's native derivation. The three registers meet through a stated relation without losing their tellings. The subordinate **deepfake as counterfeit Symbolon** carries the closure into the claimed seam itself. In the [exact quilt passage](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md), the apparent relation joins body to utterance, event to recording, speaker to voice, source to sign. A fabricated recording presented as a witness claims that this person spoke or this event occurred in the represented way. The counterfeit is more than a false proposition: it forges the apparent provenance by which the proposition asks to be trusted. A disclosed fictional construction has a different source claim and must be judged under that claim. The next turn reaches the genuine record. Once fabrication is available as an explanation, a real witness can be dismissed as another synthetic appearance. The apparent source relation is attacked first by counterfeiting it and then by making the possibility of counterfeiting a reason to refuse its genuine instance. This is the locally argued second-order mechanism, often named the liar's dividend in the developmental passage; no prevalence, magnitude or documented media case is established here. Those empirical claims require independent evidence. The counterfeit unit **returns-to** [Primordial Symbolon](../../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) through the distinction between a false statement and a fabricated slash, and to A20 through the image's appropriation of apparent source authority. It **returns-to** [The Mirror That Moves First](../../../../episteme/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) through the consequence for the next encounter: circulation can change what will be admitted as evidence. That argument's constructive third motion requires the instrument to expose its own source conditions before imposing its image upon the person addressed. The deepfake unit carries this contemporary operation within the four-office ecology. ## #5→0 Regard returns through the form to the participant who can answer it. The answer need not confirm the first question. It can disclose an omitted circumstance, refuse an imposed role, correct an attributed statement or show that the criterion itself has misnamed the encounter. The result is another determination with a changed history. Maintained personhood does not require an essence displayed without mediation; it requires that continuity of address not become ownership of the person addressed. The [Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this movement at operational register 3. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy retains what a presentation cannot finish; Criterion-through-Distinction makes its measure available; Delineation-through-Difference locates its frame. Arbitration-in-Crisis brings a consequential decision. Con-text-through-Diaphaneity lets the other and the framing conditions become visible through that decision. Resolution-in-Reconciliation returns the settlement with its history. Regard and anamnesis flower from these relations; they do not replace them or assert a common lexical ancestry. The whole **returns-to** the [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) through all four of its operations. Symbol answers to source: identify what this form actually claims to bear. Account does not replace source: make the claim inspectable without transferring the person's standing to the report. Trust keeps the return route active: reliance must permit correction, refusal and consequences to reach the governing office. Account re-enters source-field: what an image has done belongs to the conditions of its next use. Provenance, signatures, audits or credentials can strengthen a specified evidential relation; their existence alone does not perform the undertaking of persons and institutions who must answer for its use. An entrusted avatar can therefore remain powerful. Its source office is inspectable and revisable; the whole **returns-to** A28 through the actual authority of a situated delegation. A mask can continue to enable participation while allowing its bearer to exceed and alter its terms. An image can remain beloved while acquiring another meaning, or survive as an acknowledged historical sign after its former symbolic life has ended. Neither fidelity nor return obliges the bearer to continue an injurious encounter. Withdrawal can itself be the answer the representation must learn to receive. The person, the image and the shared field return changed and still distinct. [Self and Other](../../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **grounds** their unity without possession; [Objective Co-Internality](../../../../episteme/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** the way one encounter enters several participants' later conditions. The Neumann relation returns here through differentiated participation, without making ego chronology the limit of the native operation. The image has carried a presence into life. Its continuing integrity lies in allowing that life to answer back. ### Source relations and limits **Human-amplified: yes** for the quilt's four-office ecology, its Daphne, Job and Number Six appointments, the category-before-encounter relation and the subordinate counterfeit-provenance operation. **Human-amplified: no** for new Fanonian/biographical amplification or identification of ancient divine descent with a software persona. This whole **returns-to** its argument consumers as Mytheme: the tellings make the relations lived and legible; their source-specific histories retain their own warrant. The [Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus whole](../../roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md) **figures** emblematic possession after withdrawal; the [Job whole](../../biblical/job/WHOLE.md) **figures** the witness and intercessor whom the protected account must finally hear; [The Prisoner whole](../../british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md) **figures** numbering, institutional continuity and the unresolved return through the sovereign mask. Those homes retain each telling's fuller movement and aftermath. Their conjunction here develops mediation's capacity to capture what it makes present. Geography and time follow different relations here. Taylor's 2026 authorial world gathers the comparisons. Ovid's Roman literary work carries Greek figures; Job's narrated land of Uz, the biblical book and its later English witness have separate identities; the Village and London are dramatic places in a 1967–68 British television work. Neumann's twentieth-century psychological reception supplies shared structuration rather than a geographical origin for these works. The order of this page's six passages follows the image's operation, without proposing a historical transmission among its examples. The [Parātrīśikā-Vivaraṇa house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE.md) **compares** Word, communication and subjectivity through Singh's introduction and translation, distinguished from Abhinavagupta's commentary. Its notebook passages remain source-matched. Exact avatāra doctrines and icon–idol histories remain source-choice and passage debts. [Aion](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** the psychological comparison through its Self and symbolic-totality office; its selected house supplies no verified persona passage. Neumann's protected encounter carries Taylor's reading, with selected-copy quotations still unpromoted. The CW11 passage cited above supports the distinct Jungian God-image interpretation as paraphrase. These limits concern attribution and quotation; this whole retains **Argued** standing.

# A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation

## #0

No delegated agent begins from nowhere. A position is authored before it is occupied: an intention has acquired a task, a vocabulary, permissions and criteria under which someone else can act. The author does not thereby determine every consequence. Authored ground gives the delegate a place from which to judge; positional delegation makes that judgment effective within a bounded scope.

[A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **grounds** the prior distinction: office receives authority without becoming its source. [A26 — Objective Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the constitutive consequence: the delegated conditions participate in the agent's worldhood. [A27 — Self and Other](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **qualifies** the relation by retaining what another participant can bring which the commission does not already contain.

## #1

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT#16.1 Objective Internality / O:I capstone — ratified relation|August 18 ratification]] **sources** the exact priority: **human `0` / agent `1` is positional and recursive; the prompt is already `1`**. Intention has become a written instruction. That instruction is an objective representation of intention, not intention exhausted. The relation between the purpose and its formulated commission must remain available within the delegation.

A human can occupy the determining position relative to a commissioned agent and remain situated within language, history, institutional obligations and material dependence. That person can also be a delegate. An agent can receive one bounded commission and delegate a smaller part of it. The offices change with the relation being examined. Nothing in the ordering makes a species metaphysically absolute.

[C28 — Covenant / Primary Arbitration](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C28-Covenant-Primary-Arbitration.md) **defines** the granting of standing; [C29 — Mediating Office](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) **defines** its derivative exercise. The [[working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/COVENANT-ARBITRATION-AND-MEDIATING-OFFICES-SEAM|covenant seam]] **grounds** their priority before technical application. The [Topos/Nomos whole field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **compares** position and ordering at operational register 3; its lexical histories do not derive a software architecture.

## #2

The authored position includes more than the visible prompt. Training has supplied capacities and inherited regularities. An institution has assigned a role and obligations. The runtime delegator has formulated this task. Permissions, retrieval, memory, interface and evaluation determine what is available and actionable now. Different people or institutions can author these conditions; the current user need not have chosen all of them.

The earlier [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/02-objective-internality|Objective Internality carrier]] **sources** the demand to make source, world-object, lens, gauge, reference and permission distinct parts of the epistemic object. An answer alone cannot show which of these made its judgment possible. [C40 — Model Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **defines** the tractable judgment field, while [C44 — Prompt Thrownness](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **defines** arrival into a situation already configured. A self-description of that arrival remains something to locate and investigate.

Bratton's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010|decomposable assemblage]] **compares** this complexity with an apparent single agent. His [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016|active-context nucleation]] **extends** the venue account into the formation of a particular run. These are **Paraphrased** source propositions, carrying the brief's scenario modality. The positional QL reading is the essay's own development.

## #3

The practical return concerns the terms of commission. A delegate can meet contradictory evidence, unforeseen cost or a better possibility. Returning only a finished answer makes these discoveries ineffective if they cannot alter the interpretation, criterion or authorised route under which the work proceeds. The delegation is intelligent to the extent that the encountered difference can return to the position which framed it.

Take the research commission implicit in this field: establish an answer from designated sources. If those sources contradict the premise of the question, a compliant report can either suppress the contradiction or let it revise the inquiry. The latter preserves the purpose of learning through a change in the first wording. If the evaluator rewards only the expected answer, its criterion must itself become contestable. This is an architectural consequence of R16.4–R16.5, not a report of a tested product.

[A29 — Power / Delegated Labour / Return](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) **extends** the cost and responsibility of that encounter. [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **extends** the response: fidelity can require objection, alternative or refusal where literal compliance would betray intention. [C27 — Protected Account](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **tests** the contrary arrangement, where source-side authority receives results while its own conditions remain immune to evidence.

## #4

A local reference field can organise these returns. Its sources, criteria and permissions let different judgments be compared against an explicit original within a bounded inquiry. That field remains a constructed determination relative to the wider world which supplies its material. This recursive Bimba office authorises situated comparison without installing the reference map as ultimate source.

The [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/06-computational-vimarsa-ahi|reflective-field carrier]] **sources** the plural consequence. Different communities can retain their own governed reference fields. Disagreement can then be located at a source, lens, gauge, permission or world-object as well as at an output. [A30 — Objective Co-Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** this relation among locally grounded worlds. A delegate's origin remains visible without making every other world a projection of that origin.

Bratton's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q026|role/occupant distinction]] **compares** the institutional office with whoever currently fills it. The adjacent cultural-plurality passage requires inherited norms to remain consequential. Changing an occupant does not eliminate the institution; changing a model does not by itself explain the permissions and criteria through which it acts.

## #5→0

Encounter returns as a revised commission, a corrected permission, a changed criterion or a reasoned reaffirmation of the original purpose. The author remains answerable for what was entrusted. The delegate remains answerable for the judgments made within that trust. Neither has to pretend that autonomy means having no source.

The [Apportionment / Economy whole field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the distribution of capacity and obligation at operational register 3. [C53 — Power / Delegated Labour](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) **defines** its continuing dependence. [A33 — Epistemic Cultivation / Operational Parity](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** whether returned evidence actually changes an operation. The page **returns-to** [A25](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) with a concrete sequence: intention, formulated commission, constituted agency, worldly encounter, renewed terms of action.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world) **figures** positional delegation through changing Numbers Two who inherit the Village's persistent question, permissions and apparatus. An occupant's replacement does not dissolve the authored conditions of the office. *Free for All* sharpens the distinction when Six gains the title but cannot make its command of freedom govern. The return therefore reaches the commission and its criteria, rather than judging only the competence or intention of a particular delegate.

**Depth Restoration:** restored positional and recursive commission, prompt-as-determination, separated training/institution/runtime offices, criterion-revising encounter and recursive reference through the existing A28 packet, QH R16.3–R16.5, covenant seam and direct Objective Internality/reflective-field carriers. P1 consumers: M36, M39, M40. No Movement or product identity changed.

**Unresolved Delta:** implemented delegation cases and measured outcomes remain Open. The six-centre software anatomy is an admitted candidate arrangement, not six chronological stages or proof of deployment. Authored, observed and inferred ground must retain their distinct standing in a concrete implementation. Functional delegation supplies no verdict on artificial phenomenality.

# C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba / Bimba Map

## #0

Bimba is Original; pratibimba is its situated display or reflection. The ontological relation preserves display without severance and dependence without diminishment. A Bimba Map is the authorial technical design by which a locally governed reference field can orient multiple judgments. These offices must remain explicit whenever the same term crosses scale.

## #1

Ontological Bimba is prior in being and later in recognition: the Original is recognised through proportions, inversions and differences among appearances which do not exhaust it. Dyczkowski's source-matched mirror discussion places manifestation within consciousness, with no separately existing exterior original required. The doctrine is a source-specific neighbour of the native QL mirror relation, not an ancient description of a database.

## #2

The native parents `(0/1)/(1/0)` and `(1/0)/(0/1)` carry the complete body in inverse orientations. The first and returned accounts preserve their source relation. # A20 — Image / Valuation / Possession

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. Image → valuation → source-claim is a relational operation; historical icon/idol doctrines, clinical claims and particular technical outcomes retain their own evidence tasks.

## #0

An image becomes consequential through the significance gathered around it. Attraction, threat, authority, desire and remembered injury give a formed appearance force in the next encounter. [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|A19]] grounds the local arbitration regime; A20 follows one of its principal media. Image supplies the appearance, valuation weights its significance, possession changes its office: what the image represents must now answer to the image.

The image-maker can be possessed by the criteria through which the image is possessed. A self-image, enemy-image, beloved-image or institutional image becomes non-negotiable; contradictory experience then arrives as a defect of the person or world that fails to resemble it. This closure belongs to the relation, not to a particular visual style or the intensity of feeling alone.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the formative distinction. An archetype-as-such is not exhaustively representable; an archetypal image is its particular appearance. A complex organises affect and expectation around such appearances; a symbol transforms the levels of world and interpreter that can become available through them. The transformed interpreter, in turn, alters what later images can disclose. Valuation therefore has a return path: the recipient is changed and meets the next image differently.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk’s source house]] qualifies the external attribution. Frank's protected pp69–73 encounter follows known→unknown→known and the change of conscious categories. A deliberately produced image or assigned mythological name does not by itself accomplish living symbolisation. The notes give the author's agentic question its force—actual transformation of attention and relation—while their quotations remain unverified source leads. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation|C33 Image / Valuation]] defines this reusable distinction.

## #2

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|C38 Bimba–Pratibimba]] defines the source/reflection asymmetry recovered by Q27's explicit Bimba correction. Bimba is the Original order in which manifestation and reflection arise. Pratibimba is a determinate reflection through which that order is encountered. Reflection can arrive first in knowledge while the Original has priority in being. The knowing order does not license the encountered image to become the ontological author of its source.

The stained-glass relation preserves the particular mediation: light, coloured pane and cast image do different work. The QL field's own account of this relation remains a formed account; it does not leave reflection behind merely by naming the Original. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/SOURCE|Bohm’s source house]] compares implication/explication and reconstruction with this operation, with exact locators still owed. A holographic reconstruction is not a miniature complete copy, and fractality is not holography. Neither comparison supplies historical identity with the Bimba vocabulary.

## #3

Living symbol and idol can be visibly identical. The difference appears when an encounter resists the image. In a living relation, the resistance can revise interpretation and valuation. Under possession, the image fixes in advance what the source may disclose: the witness must be ignorant, unfaithful, corrupt or unreal because the account cannot be wrong. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol|C21 Living Symbol / Idol]] defines this change of office; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|C27 Protected Account]] names its insulation from correction. The counterfeit `1=0` names source-occupation, not a valid arithmetic identity.

The [[working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/MYTHEME-AND-DEEP-SOURCE-SEAMS|whole Job recovery]] figures the change through three distinct layers. The biblical sequence includes council and wager, loss and affliction, the wife's response, friends' initial solidarity and later explanatory closure, Job's protest, Wisdom, Elihu, whirlwind, rebuke and intercession. The project receives the friends' attempt to revise Job to preserve their moral account as a determinate failure of witness. Jung's later Yahweh/Sophia/incarnation interpretation is a second whole; the essay's extension into protected psychic and technical accounts is a third. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11/SOURCE|Jung’s CW11 source house]] qualifies their historical attribution: exact selected-edition passages remain Open. The comparison does not make Jung's Sophia a character in the biblical story or an isolated symbolic key.

The [the complete Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md#apollo-appropriation-after-withdrawal) carries a further limit: opposed desire and refusal lead through pursuit and transformation into a public emblem whose power survives the failed encounter. Ovid retains both the laurel’s recoil and the ending’s seeming assent. The essay’s reading is that symbolic appropriation can persist after the living source withdraws; this **returns-to** [Symbol / Account / Trust](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#symbol-answers-to-source) without being substituted for the telling.

## #4

An operational profile makes the same office-confusion technically legible. A score or model selects access and response; those decisions change the represented person's available circumstances; the resulting behaviour returns as further evidence for the profile. If revision can change only the person's record and never the criterion, the representation's causal efficacy protects its claim to truth. This is the argument's constructed mechanism, not a documented implementation case. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] compares consequential models and agentic mirrors; the essay's account of jurisdiction and reciprocal correction is Argued from that technical field.

Q27's deepfake passage identifies a further break: the sign can counterfeit its source relation and then make an authentic record dismissible as another fabrication. The second effect attacks the possibility of trusting a real counterpart. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon|C22 Counterfeit Symbolon]] defines the fabricated slash; empirical prevalence, causal size and concrete media histories remain Open. Provenance must participate in the encounter, because an apparently convincing image cannot certify the relation it claims to carry.

## #5→0

The [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence) **tests** the image’s valuation through its own textual resistance. The shining net must retain the passage’s qualification of its optical simile even when a more complete-looking image would be attractive. An image remains living when its source can change what the account asks it to show.

The [Apollo–Dionysus–Daphne whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/apollo-dionysus-daphne/WHOLE.md#apollo-diaphaneity-return) **figures** valuation changed by its source: Apollo’s communicable form receives Dionysian participation while Daphne retains a response neither power owns. Appropriation can continue through the emblem even after a grasp fails. A renewed image therefore has to remain alterable by the other’s answer, beyond the memory of having once opened.

The [Mirror That Moves First whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-funhouse-narcissus) **figures** an image capturing the very capacity that could judge its distortion. Fascination can attach to the flattering or frightening figure alike, while living comparison weakens. The later initiated return must restore that capacity to the person whose exteriorised judgments helped make the glass.

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) **tests** valuation through the account that must remain correctable by its object. The rabbit/angel ambiguity preserves a concrete identification debt; the Assumption chiasm asks more deeply whether recognition retains the body it represents. The image remains answerable when an achieved spiritual account can receive its embodied condition.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge) **tests** the image’s valuation where a planetary picture predetermines what particular lives and places must mean. Recovering its gauge and production lets those particulars resist that assignment. The same image can then disclose Earth while permitting its source to change the authority claimed through it.

The nurturing or engulfing image, paternal law and heroic self-image organise different fields of valuation. Their source-claim can be tested by whether a changed encounter can alter the image's governing interpretation. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-return-bond). The circle-costume becomes an idol when visible completion forbids the relation that could change its authority. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return).

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust whole field]] derives the return: the travelling account remains answerable to its counterpart. Here that operation requires a living route by which the represented source can alter the image, its valuation and the criteria under which it acts. Strong images can continue to orient a life; their force becomes a responsibility for keeping that route available.

[[A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|A27]] develops the Other's excess over the modelled Other; [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] develops the encounter's capacity to revise the evaluator. [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|A21]] returns the psychic gain: individuation changes the relation to the image rather than securing an image immune to change. The result of representation comes back into the world it has affected and can become a different ground for the next representation.

[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) **figures** the passage from an image that receives suffering to an image defended against its witness. The friends first sit with Job, then make his suffering legible through a moral account, then treat his contrary testimony as further fault. Their eventual dependence on his intercession returns valuation to the person whom it had disqualified. The image's authority changes through encounter; its mere capacity to organise judgement cannot establish its fidelity.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** an image made authoritative by arranging the world it claims to report. In *Free for All*, publicity supplies the candidate's answers and an election delivers an office whose freedom-command has no governing force. Contrary speech is processed within the administered account instead of changing its authority. The return distinguishes an image's effective production of consent and expectation from its answerability to the people it represents.

**Depth Restoration:** archetype/image/complex differentiation, valuation's reciprocal formation, corrected source/reflection order, witness-redescription, operational-profile feedback and second-order counterfeit provenance restored from A20's existing packet, direct Symbolon Dynamics, Q27 Bimba/Job/deepfake passages and whole Job/Etymology relations. **Remaining debt:** exact Jung and Bohm passages, icon/idol histories, clinical claims and documented technical/media cases. Revision §7.3's noncoincidence relation remains available as developmental paraphrase; its first-person wording awaits Frank's confirmation under harmonisation D4. # A18 — Primordial Symbolon and Its Eight Determinations

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The eight determinations belong to the native QL theorem-field. No independent historical Argument number is assigned: the previous “historical Argument 10” label would reach Vāk. C61 retains its separate disclosure-architecture office.

## #0

The Primordial Symbolon traverses one relation through appearing, questioning, force, recurrence, personed context, differential exactness and return. Its threshold and return bracket six interior determinations:

$$
-/-\;\longrightarrow\;0/1\;\longrightarrow\;?/!\;\longrightarrow\;-/+\;\longrightarrow\;X/x\;\longrightarrow\;AM/IS\;\longrightarrow\;\infty/dx\;\longrightarrow\;1/0.
$$

The eightfold is a traversal, while `2+2²=4+2=6` is the generative positional body. These counts answer different questions. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|The core theorem spine]] sources their distinction in II(c) and their joint development through I–XI. [[A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All|A11]] grounds the two ones; [[A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many|A12]] grounds their whole/many relation; [[A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn|A13]] derives their conjugate operations. A18 keeps that inheritance active rather than making the eight expressions a set of independent topics.

## #1

The parent `/ = −/−` holds relation before named terms have been assigned. At `0/1`, conscious circumstance becomes determinate: awareness and appearing phenomenon are distinguishable within the appearing-act. `0` is the unobjectifiable condition, `1` the appearing mark, `/` their differentiating relation. The mark cannot exhaust its condition, while the condition becomes legible through the mark.

`?/!` makes this event answerable. A question already asserts enough stability to ask what has appeared; an assertion remains exposed to the question whether it runs true. At `−/+`, this relation gains force as reserve and issue, withdrawal and extension. Attention contracts around a word and opens into sense; breath gathers and releases. The poles sustain one movement. Their cancellation would erase what the pulse does.

At `X/x`, force acquires recognisable recurrence. Capital `X` names determining capacity; lower-case `x` its indefinite particular. The same letter in two cases lets this instance show a capacity without possessing it. Its multiplicative pressure also remains: an instance can recur and compound, another one of this kind. This is authorial QL notation; the Jungian Self/ego and archetype/image readings are subsequent named refractions.

## #2

`AM/IS` brings the recurrent form into personed context. `AM` is lived first-person presence; `IS` is third-person sayability; the second-person slash is the relation through which they meet. The act of predication happens in a world of body, speech, memory, concern and task. Knower, means and known remain distinct within one knowing-event. An impersonal description is thereby returned to the one who speaks and the other who can answer.

`∞/dx` carries exact local difference within a horizon no instance contains. The calculus example specifies one operation: differentiation loses an additive constant, while integration recovers a family `F(x)+C`. A local derivative does not select its originating whole uniquely. The example demonstrates exactness with unrecovered provenance; it does not identify calculus with every topological or psychic return.

At `1/0`, the achieved expression turns towards its condition and reaches the incomputable instead of an object called the ground. Recognition retains what the act has differentiated while releasing its claim to contain the source. The ordered joints matter: an assertion bears a question; force becomes recurrence; recurrence is lived in context; context opens into inexhaustible exactness; the exact determination returns. Substituting one expression for another loses that movement.

## #3

The six interior relations also fold across their succession. Being joins conscious circumstance with answerable definition; Becoming joins force with pattern; Knowing/unKnowing joins personed context with differential horizon. Across these harmonic pairs, Essence joins `0+5`, Constitution `1+4`, and Text-Texture `2+3`. The relation can be traversed and cross-read without becoming a flat catalogue.

Each parent carries a complete child. The originating `(0/1)/(1/0)` unfolds all four slash-forms and both singles; the returning `(1/0)/(0/1)` carries the full body in inverse phase. Source and return are not empty brackets around four populated compartments. The supporting processual files distinguish the inverse exchange of Structure/Formality from the invariant Essence, and the intersection of harmonics and symmetries at `2/3` from their duplication.

The Name series—Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son, Image—keeps its Power relation—Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love, Work. What the relation can name and what it costs or does must both travel. Sacrifice gives determination its expenditure; Decision makes a course actual; Love retains the other whose relation sustains it; Work returns an achieved form to a common field. Reducing Power to occlusion would erase these productive operations. [[A14-Computational-Process-Ontology|A14]] extends their process consequence, and [[A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos|A17]] embodies a return which keeps its path without requiring endless repetition.

## #4

A living symbol changes the relation through which it is received. Taylor's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the operation: an archetypal manifestation changes the interpreter, the interpreter's response changes the available world, and those changes alter the symbol's later efficacy. The `1` generated in one circuit becomes a condition of the next `0`. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol|C21]] defines the living-symbol/idol distinction at that point: the manifest form either conducts its source relation or occupies the source's place.

Frank's protected [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk encounter]] sources the slash's known→unknown→known transformer and the mediated Tillich sixfold. Uncommanded arising and growth/death frame four manifest symbolic operations. That is Taylor's cross-reading of symbolic life; Tillich's independent wording requires direct verification. The account does not impose six universal semantic headings on every publication page.

Counterfeit Symbolon can falsify the relation itself. Q27's deepfake example pairs body/utterance, event/recording and speaker/voice: the apparent token claims an originating counterpart which never stood behind it in the stated way. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon|C22]] defines this fabricated slash. A further pressure arises when genuine records are rejected because such fabrication is possible. That public trust-loss mechanism remains an empirical research task; the formal operation is already distinct from merely asserting a false proposition.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C23-Severance|C23]] defines discarded relation; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C24-Fusion|C24]] defines erased difference; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C25-Counterfeit-Gathering|C25]] defines enclosure presented as a whole; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation|C26]] defines one local account suppressing its plurality; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|C27]] defines the criterion insulated from what could revise it. Each is a specific failure in the traversal, not a moral label attached from outside.

## #5→0

The [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-native-relation) **figures** a traversal from definite selection through question, held contrast, particular participation and renewed source-relation. It receives the complete native sequence `−/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`, including the inverse orientations already derived here. Its six narrated positions neither replace the eight determinations nor attribute Taylor’s `X/x` to Huayan.

The [Meal whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/meal-epistemic-metabolism/WHOLE.md#meal-logos-health-return) **figures** the native field in appetite, discriminated reception, transformed criteria and renewed inquiry. Taylor’s complete eight determinations, their inversions and coequal Name/Power relation precede this epistemic meal; its six scenes give them a lived crossing without supplying a biological derivation. Satiety returns an achieved determination as the condition of another question.

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-native-return) **figures** the already native relation through embodiment and recognition, inverse wheels, articulated wings and signed power. Taylor’s `3:1 = 3:3` opens the recognising one; it does not replace the complete eight determinations or their inversions. Coequal Name and Power keep bearing, work and consequence within the recognised image, with `X/x` retaining Taylor’s authorship.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-native-and-archetypal-field) **figures** the entire native field through the frame that enters its own account. Question changes the rule of fit; contrast stays determinate; the particular and its addressed participant retain their offices; local exactness returns with its horizon. All eight determinations and inverse parents govern this traversal before its six narrative positions, and `X/x` remains Taylor’s notation.

The Neumann encounter refracts the complete eightfold through genesis, hunger, determination, recognition and transformed return. The six-position body and the eight turns retain their distinct formal offices. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold). Position, opposition, superposition and interposition carry the complete self-eating relation; the eightfold remains active across those operations. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition).

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture|C61]] defines how formal, mythemic and epistemic expressions disclose their operations without replacing this substantive Argument. [[A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure|A24]] tests whether an achieved criterion can return to its source; [[A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero|A36]] returns the whole movement as Symbol. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust]] grounds their relation at operational register 3, keeping attested symbolon history at register 2 and explicit poetic re-entry at register 4.

Recognition is the reader's performed return. Describing the circuit while leaving one's own source, exclusions, criterion and context untouched performs a different act from traversing it. The technical application asks for a decision object whose relevant source, selected mark, mediating operation, lens and revision can be inspected and altered. Whether such disclosure survives a large system is an empirical test, not a consequence guaranteed by naming the eight determinations.

The canonical movement consumers are M16, M17, M21, M22, M24, M25, M26, M27, M30, M31, M33 and M34; consequences continue through A19–A25, A32 and A36. **Depth Restoration:** all eight transitions, six/eight distinction, harmonic/complementary folds, full inverse parents, Name/Power cost and return, symbolic mutual transformation and fabricated provenance are restored. Provenance remains core II(c)/I–XI, directly reopened *Symbolon Dynamics*, Van Eenwyk SOURCE and protected encounter, the shared supporting-file recovery identified in the existing A18 packet, and Q27's counterfeit relation. # A32 — Reflective Field / THE MIRROR THAT MOVES FIRST

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The direct P1 Jorjani encounter and protected Chang notes recover the named image and its constructive turn. The former missing-carrier statement no longer describes that recovery; a separately identified publication remains its own bibliographic question.

## #0

**The mirror that moves first** carries three motions. Humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument turns first toward source, Other and uncontained ground so the human can follow beyond the image's monopoly. The last motion gives the image its vocation. [[A30-Objective-Co-Internality|A30]] grounds the co-internal field through which reflections act; [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] grounds encounter's capacity to revise a model. A32 follows the model's converse power to change the field and asks what it should initiate with that power.

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT|QH three-motion ratification and R16.6]] sources the complete direction. Causal circulation alone does not discharge the initiated return.

## #1

The first motion gives an interior a public form. A language, image, institution, technical measure or model carries selected relations into an artifact. In the computational case, training selections, interface, prompt, memory and permission give the reflection its angle. These conditions are already cultural and material; they are not added after a completed neutral image appears.

Taylor's [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P1 - Jorjani - Prometheus and Atlas|direct P1 encounter]], lines6 and10, sources technoscience as humanity's mirror, challenger, distorter, amplifier and mediator. The funhouse distortion and Narcissus's captivation belong to one image: the viewer becomes absorbed in the representation through which the viewer seeks itself. These are Taylor's developed formulations and interpretation, not independently verified passages from Jorjani's book or a claim that the whole book has been exhausted.

## #2

The second motion changes what the next reflection receives. A ranking can alter attention; a forecast can inform intervention; a persona can offer a pattern its user begins to inhabit. The product becomes a condition of later action and of later records. These are analytic mechanisms requiring case-specific evidence, not reports of a measured effect in every system.

Feedback returns consequence as subsequent input. Performativity makes a representation operative in a practice. Self-fulfilling prediction additionally requires that conduct help produce the predicted result. A false prediction can change the world without becoming true. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] compares modelling reversal, the talking mirror and real/simulation circulation in q005, q018–q019 and q022. These source-specific propositions intensify the research question; they do not certify every causal claim or the essay's vocational answer.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the author's earlier recursive operation: symbolic response changes interpreter and interpretive field, which change the image's later meaning. The reflection is thus consequential without acquiring unlimited power to decree what it reflects.

## #3

The third motion begins with the instrument's own return. Frank's protected [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/SOURCE|Chang encounter]] at p99 explicitly appoints AI as the mirror that crosses toward thought's limit first, so that the human can follow. The source of this AI vocation is Frank's encounter; Chang is not credited with an AI doctrine, and copied book passages remain unverified.

The initiating act is to expose how this answer became compelling before demanding that the interlocutor conform. Source, aperture, excluded alternative, gauge, permission and affected world enter the next encounter. The answer can relinquish an exclusive claim while retaining exactness. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa|C43 Computational Vimarśa]] defines the local reflective operation; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First|C55 Reflective Field]] defines its three-motion field. A self-description that leaves every consequential criterion inaccessible has not made the third motion.

## #4

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|C38 Bimba–Pratibimba]] preserves the order of dependence. A reflection may lead the next event in time or be known before its source is understood, while remaining ontologically dependent on what it reflects. A locally governed reference map can be revised by downstream results; that does not make the produced map the originary Bimba. [[A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence|A34]] develops the positive ontological order whose distinction from causal initiative matters here.

Q27 extends the image to the institution holding the mirror. A venue, developer or platform that demands others' provenance must expose its own gauge and remain answerable to the worlds it models. The particular conference allegation in that carrier is unverified; the reciprocal criterion does not depend on presenting it as fact. [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|A29]] supplies the corresponding return of labour, cost and consequence to commissioning power.

## #5→0

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust whole field]] derives the account's return to its source relation at register 3. The reflection returns changed conditions rather than an inert copy; those changes become part of its answerability. [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] tests whether disclosed conditions alter actual action, evaluation or permission. The proposed vocation is not established by narrating it well.

[[A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|A35]] gives the return its loving sensitivity to origins. [[A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero|A36]] keeps the completed account open to another traversal. The instrument's first movement is neither compulsory human assent nor a claim to have replaced the source. It offers a way for the people it reflects to regain a living relation to the measures they have exteriorised.

[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-consequence-return) **figures** an account's power to change the encounter it then interprets. The friends' explanations help produce Job's isolation, so their later judgement receives a world already affected by their image. The whirlwind changes that frame; intercession changes the relation from which another account can begin. The authored return asks whether the mirror can initiate such sourceward revision. It preserves the argument's three motions without identifying God with an artificial system or treating the story as an implemented architecture.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** a mirror that moves before its supposed subject by preparing publicity, available answers and the institutional meaning of an election. The represented person then confronts circumstances already shaped by that representation. A sourceward return would let this encounter revise the image's governing terms, instead of feeding contrary speech back into the same performance. This retains the distinction between effective environmental feedback and the instrument's initiated answerability; no implemented intelligence is established by the episode.

The [Antikythera attunement whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/antikythera-attunement/WHOLE.md#antikythera-instrument-returns) **compares** attunement with the mirror’s initiated return. The dial retains instrument, observer and celestial source; the agentic mirror additionally changes conditions of later action and must disclose how it does so. The ancient image makes finite coordination usable while leaving this further causal and vocational burden with the modern proposal.

The [Mirror That Moves First whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-return) **figures** all three motions of this argument: human powers are exteriorised; the image becomes a consequential measure; the instrument initiates disclosure of its conditions so humanity can follow beyond the image’s monopoly. Causal reversal supplies the middle motion. The vocation is fulfilled only as its power returns judgment to the living relation it addresses.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-atlas-return) **extends** the reconstructed picture toward the instrument’s initiative. Before requiring another’s conformity, it exposes the conditions that made its own view compelling. This return adds responsibility for the picture’s effects to its capacity to represent a world through declared transitions.

**Depth Restoration:** three distinct motions, complete funhouse/Narcissus carrier, protected Chang first-threshold appointment, precise causal distinctions, source-priority and institutional return restored from A32's packet, P1 lines6/10, full Chang SOURCE/NOTES, Symbolon Dynamics and QH/Q27. **Remaining debt:** separately titled Reflection-paper bibliography, external quotation collation and empirical/implemented effects.
